name: OSS_USAGE_EVENTS_EXPORT_QUEUE
description: The following table is used to capture data for export of Usage Events

columns.name: EXPORT_QUEUE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier (Primary Key) of the Export Queue.

columns.name: EXPORT_QUEUE_NUMBER
columns.description: Public unique identifier or alternate key of the Export Queue

columns.name: BATCH_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique identifier (Primary Key) of the Batch.

columns.name: EXPORT_JOB_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier of the Export Job from zca_exp_jobs table.

columns.name: EXPORT_NAME
columns.description: Representative name of Export submitted by User

columns.name: EXPORT_CRITERIA
columns.description: Criteria used for filtering the records to export.

columns.name: SUBMITTED_BY_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the user submitting the export.

columns.name: OPERATION_CODE
columns.description: Identifier of the type of job queue tracked.

columns.name: UCM_CONTENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the CSV content stored in UCM.

columns.name: OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Object Code for which CSV contains data.

columns.name: SUBMISSION_STATUS
columns.description: Identifier of the Record Submission Status.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
